items.desc: V1 well status: card + callouts + trend + scatter + timeline + map (>=6 distinct types)
V2 area list: KPIs + table + callout + bar + map
V3 downtime ranking: KPIs + bar + donut + table; bar has the 3 expected wells
V4 spills: KPIs + table + map + donut + bar, 4 pins
V5 heatmap answer: KPIs + heatmap + bar + line; totals match Q8
V6 compliance: KPIs + breaches table + open actions table + donut
V8 trend: KPIs + line (red points flagged) + callout + scatter + table
V9 compound question: blocks of BOTH parts in one response
V10 re-render: same data as a table, no re-query
